stop_rule: Stop a configuration on unchanged numerical tolerance, runtime, OOM or nonfinite failure. Preserve it; do not loosen gates. No automatic training expansion from timing alone.
scope: Zero optimizer updates. FP32 master weights and LoRA with either FP32 operations (BF16 attention) or BF16 autocast. 0.5B Qwen2.5, not full-parameter pretraining or Qwen4. Prefill includes a fresh KV cache and final-token logits only; forward/backward includes full-token LM head, FP32 cross entropy and zero_grad, excludes optimizer, input transfer and gradient checks. Timings pair within the same precision and sequence length. Inputs concatenate two previously used training windows; the join is only for cost profiling, not language quality evaluation. No report/test windows or training checkpoint selection. Two reversed-order rounds are timing repeats, not independent training seeds.
